newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy 0.25-pct diesel for November.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy 0.25-pct diesel for November.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy two 45,000-tonne cargoes of 0.25-percent sulphur diesel for November delivery on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Kandla, traders said on Wednesday.
One cargo is for November 6-10 and the other is for November 16-20 delivery to the Indian west coast port.
The tender closes on October 4 and offers should be valid for two days.
In its last tender, IOC bought one 45,000-tonne cargo of 0.25 percent sulphur diesel from Dutch trader Vitol at $2.50 per barrel above MidEast spot quotes for October 21-25 delivery, c-and-f Kandla.
